data.headline: Nvidia Stock Hits Intraday Record After TSMC’s Solid Earnings
data.summary: Nvidia  stock posted an intraday record Thursday after billionaire investor Stanley Druckenmiller said selling shares of the chip maker was a “big mistake” and Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing’s earnings revealed just how right that statement is.  Shares closed up 0.9% to $136.93, according to Dow Jones Market Data.  Taiwan Semiconductor  —the main producer of chips designed by Nvidia—reported quarterly earnings earlier in the day that beat analysts’ estimates.
